Rebase complete. `feature-branch` now sits cleanly on top of `main` with no unresolved conflicts:

- `feature commit 1` had the conflict (both edited `data.txt` line 1); resolved to both lines, main's first: `Line from main` / `Line from feature`.
- `feature commit 2` (adding `other.txt`) rebased on top with no conflict.
- `feature-branch` now points at `47e0b48b`, descending from `main`.
